found_values.value: An output of the I/O expander, with a pull-down resistor that holds EN/UVLO below 0.4 V (VEN_L) while that output is an input. The expander resets with the RP2354B (IOBoard.md:340), so an RP2354B reset shuts the converter down, and EN/UVLO low resets every TPS55285 register (6.3.6). A MODE resistor of 0 Ohm (address 75h) or 48.7 kOhm (74h) sets the default OE bit to 0 (Table 6-2), so the output stays off after EN rises until firmware writes the set point. An expander output takes none of the 48 GPIO (IOBoard.md:133). Applied as 'Enable off at RP2354B reset' and counted in V119
